description: Seismic Fragility Analysis of Safety-Related Electrical Cabinets with Seismic Protection Systems is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Sina Kavei, University of California San Diego (ucsd.edu). This project contains the complete dataset supporting the study "Seismic Fragility Analysis of Safety-Related Electrical Cabinets with Seismic Protection Systems." The repository includes all input and output data required to reproduce the numerical simulations, figures, tables, and analyses presented in the associated publication. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 20 top-level files (XLSX, CSV). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-rgws-cv63. Keywords: Non-structural elements, Fragility analysis, Separation of Variables (SOV), Incremental dynamic analysis (IDA), Seismic isolation, Tuned mass damper. Published 2026-08-05. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
